data_output.description: The fixed training command must write the requested NPZ output containing exactly two arrays: row_ids and scores. row_ids must equal int64 indices 0..N-1 in the canonical validation-row order produced by data.py encoding; scores must be a finite one-dimensional float array of length N aligned positionally with row_ids. Ground-truth labels must not be read by the training command except where already required for training and validation early stopping; final metric ground truth is owned by the fixed evaluator.

model_input.description: Model methods receive encoded feature matrices shaped (N, 2), dtype int32, with additive globally offset user_id and video_id indices as produced by data.encode. The scorer must return one finite scalar logit per row, shaped (N,), and retain the existing ID-sum architecture. Pairwise training must accept positive and negative feature rows from the same user and optimize softplus(-(positive_logit-negative_logit)); sampling must be deterministic under config seed, bounded in cost, and safely handle users lacking either class. Validation predictions must use the unchanged feature-row order.
